## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo doc --workspace --no-deps`
- [ ] Hardware-dependent behavior tested, or not applicable

List the Windows version, MIDI/audio hardware, and manual workflow tested when relevant.

## Documentation and safety

- [ ] User/developer documentation is updated when behavior or architecture changes
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, build output, or unlicensed media are included
